tasks.title: Job management service: construct once in the composition root
tasks.objective: Build JobManagementService once inside startControlServer, inject it as ctx.jobManagement, and switch all 13 per-request construction sites (jobs.ts, guided-actions.ts, models.ts, external-ingress-adapter.ts) to it. Every post-boot-mutable dependency (tool repository IfReady, runtime-store repos) is injected as an explicit getter so liveness is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: createJobManagementService is invoked exactly once per control server (composition root); no route or adapter constructs it per request

toolRepository is read through a getter at use time: a request before storage init sees undefined, a request after init sees the real repository — proven by a test that fails if the value is latched at construction
runtime-store-derived deps (control/ops/runtimeEvents/skill/mcp repos) are read through getters, preserving today's per-use semantics for tests that swap storage
credential broker and browser status remain live through the existing ctx getters
guided-actions-routes.test.ts injects its fake via the new ctx.jobManagement seam instead of mocking the module export
existing suites job-trigger.test.ts, external-ingress-adapter.test.ts, guided-actions-routes.test.ts pass unmodified in behavior
the required JUnit proofs name real testcases (contract fix; no functional change)

tasks.title: Session interaction module: one boot instance; liveAdmissionAppId becomes a method argument
tasks.objective: Build SessionInteractionModule once in startControlServer as ctx.sessionInteraction, delete the per-request helpers in session-interaction-adapter.ts and the hand-built copy in external-ingress-adapter.ts, and move liveAdmissionAppId off the constructor onto the one method that uses it so the per-caller difference is explicit and behavior-identical.
acceptance_criteria: SessionInteractionModule is constructed exactly once per control server; routes/sessions.ts, session-interaction-adapter.ts and external-ingress-adapter.ts all use ctx.sessionInteraction

liveAdmissionAppId is no longer a constructor input; the accepting method takes it as an argument; message-accept and external-ingress pass the value they compute today, the seven plain session routes pass nothing — pinned by a call-site-level test
getConfiguredAgentRuntime and runtime-store deps stay live via getters
no compatibility shim: the old constructor shape and per-request factory exports are gone, and nothing else in the repo references them
existing session and ingress suites pass with unchanged behavior
